newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telebras eyes new ADR, debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telebras eyes new ADR, debt issue.

text.p: Brazil's Telebras is likely to issue a roughly $500 million Eurobond next year and is studying the possible launch of American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) representing its ordinary shares, an official said.
"We are studying the matter," said Telebras' finance chief Sergio Pereira of a possible ADR launching.
He told reporters the move would increase the shares liquidity but added: "It's only a possibility. It's a long ways from becoming reaility."
Pereira also said the firm will not issue new shares in the near future because that would dilute stock prices ahead of the firm's privatization.
Telebras preferred share trades on the New York Stock Exchange as level 3 ADRs and is the benchmark share on the SaoPaulo exchange.
Meanwhile, Pereira said Telebras will probably launch some $500 million in debt on global markets sometime in 1997 but did not provide further details.
